good.title: 👍 Good fit if you…
items: Are a B2B SaaS or tech company with proven product-market fit
Can invest at least €1,500 a month in LinkedIn ads
See LinkedIn as a place to build brand recall, not just a lead machine
Have people in your team with something to say

notFit.title: 👎 Probably not a fit if you…
items: Are still figuring out who your customer is
Need demos next week from a small test budget
Expect ads to fix a product or pricing problem
